scripts.text: - There is a strange distortion here -
scripts.translation: - 這裡有一種奇怪的扭曲 -

scripts.text: Extend your hand.
scripts.translation: 伸出手

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text: - I extend my arm as a fierce sound resonates in my ear and a cool wave surrounds me -
scripts.translation: - 我伸出手臂，耳邊響起一陣劇烈的聲響，一股涼意將我包圍 -

scripts.text: - You ignore the distortion. -
scripts.translation: - 你無視了這種扭曲。 -

scripts.text: - There is a strange distortion here -
scripts.translation: - 這裡有一種奇怪的扭曲 -

scripts.text: Search the area.
scripts.translation: 搜尋周圍

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text: - There appears to be nothing here. But I can definitely feel something around here... -
scripts.translation: - 這裡似乎什麼都沒有。但我確實能感覺到周圍有什麼東西... -

scripts.text: Extend arm.
scripts.translation: 伸出手臂

scripts.text: Leave it alone.
scripts.translation: 先放著吧。

scripts.text: - I extend my arm as a fierce sound resonates in my ear and a cool wave surrounds me -
scripts.translation: - 我伸出手臂，耳邊響起一陣劇烈的聲響，一股涼意將我包圍 -

scripts.text: - You decide to leave it alone. -
scripts.translation: - 你決定不管它。 -

scripts.text: - You ignore it. -
scripts.translation: - 你無視了它。 -

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Huh!!! Human!?!
How did you enter here?
This is only connected with a special gate!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
什...什麼？！人類？！
你是怎麼進來的？
這裡只有通過特殊的門才能連線！

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
I don't know how...
But we should leave before my master spots you...!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
我不知道...
但我們得趁師父發現你之前離開...！

scripts.text:
[???]
What's that noise out there?
I warned them to be quiet while I'm meditating.
scripts.translation:
[???]
外面那是什麼聲音？
我明明警告過你們，我冥想時要保持安靜。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Huh!?!
Master...
It's nothing...
scripts.translation:
[助手]
什...什麼？！
師父...
沒什麼事...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Oh~ there's a human being in front of me.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
哦~ 我面前有個人類。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Oh this thing?
I was just leading it out.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
哦，那個啊？
我正準備把它帶出去。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Yoop!!!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
尤普！！！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Yeap...!!

[Master]
There's the warp portal beyond you... Is it an illusion?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你身後有個傳送之陣... 那是<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Sorry!!!
It's my mistake...
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
對不起！！！
是我的錯...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Fool...
I'll deal with you after you send the human away.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
蠢貨...
等你把人類送走，我再收拾你。

scripts.text:
[Master]
MushSartas Ir Cyamar
UdenLo
scripts.translation:
[師父]
MushSartas Ir Cyamar
UdenLo

scripts.text:
- The fairy with the green hair chants a spell. - 
 - I feel like something special surrounds me. -
scripts.translation:
- 綠髮妖精吟唱著咒語。 - 
 - 我感覺有什麼特別的東西環繞著我。 -

scripts.text:
[Master]
Oh, that's interesting.
How dare you resist me human?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
哦，這很有趣。
人類，你竟敢反抗我？

scripts.text: I'm not sure. Who are you?
scripts.translation: 我不確定。你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Master]
I am the leader of the ^000077Warlock^000000s.
'^000077Sila Egnoloria^000000'
If you are a Wizard, it would be good of you to memorize my name.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我是^000077大魔導士^000000的首領。
'^000077艾格諾洛莉亞^000000'
如果你是巫師，最好記住我的名字。

scripts.text: What is a ^000077Warlock^000000?

[Master Egnoloria]
Oh...are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
哦...你有興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
A ^000077Warlock^000000 is someone who uses the magic of the giants of Jotunheim.
It can't be defined in any other words.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
^000077大魔導士^000000是運用約頓海姆巨人魔法的人。
無法用其他詞語來定義。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Only the strong magic can explain it.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
只有強大的魔法才能解釋它。

scripts.text: Could I become Warlock?
scripts.translation: 我可以成為大魔導士嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
You?
You want to become a Warlock?
Hahaha
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
你？
你想成為大魔導士？
哈哈哈

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
You're so interesting.
It would be difficult for a human to become a Warlock.
The strong power would gnaw at your weak body.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
你很有趣。
人類要成為大魔導士是很困難的。
強大的力量會侵蝕你脆弱的身體。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
If you dare to face death, you can try to become one.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
如果你敢面對死亡，你可以嘗試成為大魔導士。

scripts.text: What do I need to do?
scripts.translation: 我需要做什麼？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Are you serious?
You hunger for power don't you human.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
你是認真的嗎？
你渴望力量，不是嗎，人類。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
The strong desire to be more powerful makes your soul more beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
渴望變得更強大的強烈慾望，會讓你的靈魂更加美麗。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
But, I need to check that you're qualified.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
但是，我需要檢查你是否符合條件。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Yoop!
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
尤普！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Yeap!!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
耶！！

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Give this to the human.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
把這個給人類。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Talk to the guy with the weird hair.
He'll let you know what you should do.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
去和那個頭髮奇怪的人談談。
他會告訴你該怎麼做。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Good.
You are a human being so that's for you.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
很好。
你是人類，所以這是給你的。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You're still quite far too low of a level to even consider this.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你的等級還太低了，根本不夠資格考慮這件事。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
You're... we've met before.
Can you imagine how severely I was scolded by my master?!
If you have any business with me, just go away!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你...我們以前見過。
你能想像我被師父罵得多慘嗎？！
如果你有什麼事找我，就請走吧！

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Leave me alone...!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
別煩我...

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
What?!
Just do whatever you want...
My master will deal with you then.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
什麼？！
隨你便...
到時候師父會處理你的。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Dear, master! My pony-tail is funny looking?!
Oh, but I spent a lot time on it!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
親愛的師父！我的馬尾辮看起來很滑稽嗎？！
啊，但我花了很多時間打理它呢！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
First, use all of your remaining job skill points before continuing.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
首先，在繼續之前，請用完你剩餘的職業技能點。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
This is the Master's
decision so let me know.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
這是師父的決定，所以請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
It's noisy.
I need to meditate
so do as I said.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
太吵了。
我需要冥想，所以照我說的做。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Huh..
Oh, yeah!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
嗯..
哦，對了！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Hey, human!
Would you like to
become a Warlock?
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
嘿，人類！
你想成為大魔導士嗎？

scripts.text: First, use all of your remaining job skill points before continuing.
scripts.translation: 首先，在繼續之前，請用完你剩餘的職業技能點。

scripts.text:
This is the Master's
decision so let me know.
scripts.translation: 這是師父的決定，所以請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
We need to test if your body can withstand being a Warlock.
So you need to gather materials to prove yourself.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我們需要測試你的身體是否能承受成為大魔導士的負擔。
所以你需要收集材料來證明你自己。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Please gather ^000077Glittering Crystal^000000s and ^000077Giant Bradium Fragment^000000s.

[Yoop]
I can't conduct the task here. I need to go to my lab.
My lab is located on the north western part of Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我不能在這裡進行任務。我需要去我的實驗室。
我的實驗室位於輝煌領域的西北部分。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
This stone is well made.
Please go to my Master.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
這塊石頭製作得很好。
請去找我的師父。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
A Magic Chamber is created from magic materials.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
魔法室是由魔法材料製成的。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
This combined stone is formed differently according to the raw materials and the way of treating it.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
這種組合石會根據原材料和處理方式的不同而呈現出不同的形態。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
But most of stones are quite similar!
We can't differentiate them easily.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
但大多數石頭的樣子都很相似！
我們很難輕易區分它們。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Even I don't know how it all works.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
連我自己也不知道這到底是怎麼運作的。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
You must be wearing these Magical Stone Rings to get these items while hunting.
You need to hunt Naga and Bradium Golems while wearing these rings.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你必須佩戴這些輪迴之石戒指，才能在狩獵時獲得這些物品。
你需要佩戴這些戒指去狩獵那迦和沉醉於魔力的石錘巨人。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Show us how strong you are. And don't forget to wear this.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
讓我們看看你的實力有多強。別忘了佩戴這個。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Bring these stones with you or else you won't be able to return!
Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
把這些石頭帶上，否則你將無法返回！
小心！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
The person next to my Master will let you out if you talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我師父旁邊的人會放你出去的，只要你跟他說話。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
My lab is located on the north western part of Splendide. Bring these to me when you've gathered them.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我的實驗室位於輝煌領域的西北部分。收集好後請把這些帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Who are you?
Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你是誰？
給我出去！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
You're back?
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你回來了？

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
I am focusing on meditating.
So I can create magic.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我正在專心冥想。
這樣我才能施展魔法。

scripts.text: I brought the materials.
scripts.translation: 我帶來了材料

scripts.text: I've lost the Magical Stones.
scripts.translation: 我弄丟了輪迴之石

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
......
......Where?
Don't bother me!

[Yoop]
Bring me back the magical stones.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
把那些魔法石頭帶回來給我。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
It seems that you don't have it?
You lost it?
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
看來你沒有帶在身上？
你把它弄丟了？

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Alright! All the materials are ready!
While I am concentrating on working on this stone. Can you go back to my master?
I will follow up once it's done.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
太好了！所有材料都準備好了！
在我專心處理這塊石頭的時候，你能去見見我的師父嗎？
完成後我會去找他。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
[Yoop]
What?!
I asked you to double check it and make sure you wore it!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
什麼？！
我讓你仔細檢查並確保你佩戴了它！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
We need to test if your body can withstand being a Warlock.
So you need to gather materials to prove yourself.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我們需要測試你的身體是否能承受成為大魔導士的負擔。
所以你需要收集材料來證明你自己。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Please gather ^000077Glittering Crystal^000000s and ^000077Giant Bradium Fragment^000000s.

[Yoop]
You must be wearing these Magical Stone Rings to get these items while hunting.
You need to hunt Naga and Bradium Golems while wearing these rings.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你必須佩戴這些輪迴之石戒指，才能在狩獵時獲得這些物品。
你需要佩戴這些戒指去狩獵那迦和沉醉於魔力的石錘巨人。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Bring these stones with you or else you won't be able to return!
Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
把這些石頭帶上，否則你將無法返回！
小心！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Please find that stone and come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
請找到那塊石頭，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
What?!
I asked you to double check it and make sure you wore it!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
什麼？！
我讓你仔細檢查並確保你佩戴了它！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Please check whether you misplaced it or if you already have it equipped.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
請檢查是否放錯了地方，或者是否已經裝備上了。

scripts.text: I found it.
scripts.translation: 我找到了。

scripts.text: Nah.
scripts.translation: 不了。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Don't tease me!
It's not hard to tell if you have it or not!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
別逗我了！
你身上有沒有，我一眼就能看出來！

scripts.text: Give 3 carat diamond.
scripts.translation: 交出3克拉鑽石。

scripts.text: Just quit it.
scripts.translation: 別鬧了。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
I will overlook your fault.
Please be careful with it.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我就原諒你這次吧。
請小心保管它。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Just show me your good faith!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
請拿出你的誠意！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
How can you can say that?
^000077Just apologize^000000!
I guess I could give you more stones if you give me say a 3 carat diamond...
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你怎麼能這麼說？
^000077快道歉^000000！
如果你給我一塊3克拉的鑽石...我想我可以多給你一些石頭...

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Please check your equipment window...
You sure you don't have it?
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
請檢查你的裝備欄...
你確定你沒有嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Then what's that you are holding now...?
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
那你現在手裡拿的是什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
What...?
Don't bother me, I am quite busy.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
什麼...？
別煩我，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
And... you seem to have more talent on this than regular mages.
Maybe if I become an alchemist, I might be better than I am now don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
而且...你在這方面似乎比普通的魔法師更有天賦。
也許如果我成為鍊金術士，會比現在更強，你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
I'm studying to better myself.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我正在努力學習，讓自己變得更強。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
If am inside of 'the room of time and magic', I will catch up with your power!
Hahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
如果我在“時間與魔法的房間”裡，一定能追上你的力量！
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Human! What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
人類！你想幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
It's not me you are looking for currently.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
你現在找的不是我。

scripts.text:
You're carring out too many items.
You'd better minimize your weight.
scripts.translation:
你攜帶的物品太多了。
最好減輕一下負重。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
The test isn't that hard.
We can create the magic stone in the magic room.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
測試沒那麼難。
我們可以在魔法房間裡製作魔法之石。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Be careful of the monsters in the test room.
These are rainbow Rubies sealed with a Warlock's magic.
Use these during the test.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
小心測試房間裡的魔物。
這些是用大魔導士的魔法封印的彩虹紅寶石。
在測試中使用這些。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
I will guide you into the magic room.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我會引導你進入魔法房間。

scripts.text:
You're carring out too many items.
You'd better minimize your weight.
scripts.translation:
你攜帶的物品太多了。
最好減輕一下負重。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Would you like to try it again?
Let me give you more rubies.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你想再試一次嗎？
讓我再給你一些紅寶石。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
You have successfully crystallized the Hollow Stone.
I'm sorry that I've doubted you.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
你成功地將空洞之石結晶化了。
抱歉，我之前懷疑了你。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
All of the tests are done. Now talk to Master Engoloria.
I'm so happy that you have succeeded.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
所有測試都完成了。現在去和艾格諾洛莉亞大師談談吧。
你成功了，我真高興。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
All of the tests are done. Now talk to Master Engoloria.
I'm so happy that you have succeeded.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
所有測試都完成了。現在去和艾格諾洛莉亞大師談談吧。
你成功了，我真高興。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
I can feel that you have strong magic.
I envy you.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
我能感覺到你擁有強大的魔力。
我真羨慕你。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
It deserves something special.
Don't abuse it.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
它值得擁有特別的東西。
不要濫用它。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
......
If you don't have anything to say to me, would you just leave?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
......
如果你沒什麼要對我說的，請離開好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
......
I don't have a pony-tail...
scripts.translation:
[助手]
......
我沒有扎馬尾辮...

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
......
Please be quiet while my master is meditating.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
......
請保持安靜，師父正在冥想。

scripts.text: Leave
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: Stay
scripts.translation: 停牌

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Then be careful.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
那麼請小心。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
......

[Master Egnoloria]
Do you have something to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
你有什麼想問我的嗎？

scripts.text: How can I be a Warlock?
scripts.translation: 如何成為大魔導士？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Are you serious?
You hunger for power don't you human.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
你是認真的嗎？
你渴望力量，不是嗎，人類。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
The strong desire to be more powerful makes your soul more beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
渴望變得更強大的強烈慾望，會讓你的靈魂更加美麗。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
But, I need to check that you're qualified.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
但是，我需要檢查你是否符合條件。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Yoop!
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
尤普！

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Yeap!!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
耶！！

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Give this to the human.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
把這個給人類。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Talk to the guy with the weird hair.
He'll let you know what you should do.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
去和那個頭髮奇怪的人談談。
他會告訴你該怎麼做。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Good.
You are a human being so that's for you.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
很好。
你是人類，所以這是給你的。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
I'm meditating, I said talk to Yoop ok.
Yoop has a funny pony-tail.
And don't disturb me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
我在冥想，我說過找尤普。
尤普有個有趣的馬尾辮。
別打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
......
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
......

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Master is meditating.
Be quiet.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
師父正在冥想。
請保持安靜。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
I've heard from Yoop that a very useful stone can be created.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
我從尤普那裡聽說可以製作一種非常有用的石頭。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
It can be used to make magical jewelry that can cast powerful magic.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
它可以用來製作能施展強大魔法的魔法飾品。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Yoop.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
尤普。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Yeap, Master!
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
是的，師父！

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Please take him to the magical room.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
請帶他去魔法房間。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
Yup, Master.
Please follow me.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
好的，師父。
請跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
......
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
......

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
My master is meditating now, please follow me.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
師父正在冥想，請跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Hm...?
How did you come this far...
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
嗯...？
你是怎麼走到這裡的...

scripts.text:
You've got too many items.
Please come back after reducing the number of items you have.
scripts.translation:
你攜帶的物品太多了。
請減少物品數量後再來。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Unless you like your current job, you should use all your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
除非你滿意當前的職業，否則你應該使用所有的技能點。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
You are on a riding pet,
so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
你正騎著寵物，
所以無法轉職。
請卸下坐騎後再試一次！

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
Beautiful light...
Don't make me disappointed at you...
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
美麗的光芒...
不要讓我對你失望...

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
You have become a member of the Warlocks.
Be proud.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
你已成為大魔導士的一員。
請為此感到自豪。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou still have left the skill points, Please use all the skill points and try to start again!^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你還有剩餘的技能點，請使用完所有技能點後再試一次！^000000

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
This crystallized magical stone will keep you safe.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
這塊結晶化的魔法石會保護你的安全。

scripts.text:
[Master Egnoloria]
How are you adjusting to the power of a Warlocks?
If you get careless, you will be overthrown by your own power.
scripts.translation:
[艾格諾洛莉亞大師]
你適應大魔導士的力量了嗎？
如果你變得大意，就會被自己的力量所吞噬。

scripts.text:
[Yoop]
If you ask Ebein to be sent to the magical room, he would send you there.
Wait in the queue to enter the Chamber of Magic.
scripts.translation:
[尤普]
如果你讓埃貝因把你送到魔法房間，他會把你送過去。
請在佇列中等待進入魔法室。

scripts.text:
[Ebein]
Would you like to take a test?
If you stand by in the waiting room, you'll be able to go into the Chamber of Magic.
scripts.translation:
[埃貝因]
你想參加測試嗎？
如果你站在等候室，就可以進入魔法室。

scripts.text:
[Ebein]
If there're others inside the room, you just need to wait for a while.
scripts.translation:
[埃貝因]
如果房間裡還有其他人，你只需要稍等片刻。

scripts.text: Go to the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 去等候室

scripts.text: Go outside.
scripts.translation: 出去

scripts.text:
[Ebein]
Then please enter the room yourself.
Make sure you have enough potions to survive the test as the monsters are very powerful in the Chamber.
scripts.translation:
[埃貝因]
那麼請自己進入房間。
確保你有足夠的藥水來通過測試，因為房間裡的魔物非常強大。

scripts.text:
[Ebein]
......
Then I will send you outside.
Bye...
scripts.translation:
[埃貝因]
......
那麼我會把你送出去。
再見...
